quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn press release: Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn) and Mitsubishi (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Foxconn and Mitsubishi Electric formalized (October 16, 2026) a strategic alliance for the joint operation of an automotive equipment business: Mitsubishi Electric will transfer to Lin Yin International Investment, an investment management subsidiary of Foxconn, 50% of its stake in Mitsubishi Electric Mobility (which handles Mitsubishi Electric's automotive equipment business), after which the two co-owners will jointly operate it. The arrangement combines Mitsubishi Electric Mobility's capabilities in electric powertrains, software and vehicle control with Foxconn's speed, scale and strengths in market deployment; by providing electric-vehicle platforms developed in Japan the companies expect to contribute to the adoption of next-generation mobility, and over the medium to long term they aim to expand Japanese technology and quality to global markets. The share transfer is expected to be completed on October 1, 2027, subject to approvals under competition and other laws.
quarterly_data.figure: 50% of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility; completion expected October 1, 2027
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: alliance partner (co-owner of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility)
